sentence: The room's call to place, rebuild after loss, neighbour bargaining, defence, rival attack and final celebration restate the model's call, move, border, keeping, contest and close elements, but its unused voting-button and subreddit-style themes carry organizing the model lacks.

The room's place work restates in the model's terms — the call to place the Spur [t07], rebuilding and choosing a spot [t09], bargaining borders and upkeep with neighbours [t10], repair and defence [t14], the call on the Warriors logo [t15], the move of work into Discord [t18], and celebrating the Spur's survival [t21] — but t17's downvote-button deliberation (c0103–c0121) carries subreddit-UI organizing the model lacks.
